neighbours.label: A word right after a period (a sentence boundary or an abbreviation such as 'U.S.'), other than the very common ' The', against the same word inside a sentence.
fire: It was cold. Nobody answered the door.
The shop closed. then it rained.
He works at Acme Inc. Denver is home.
We are in the U.S. Texas is big.
She spoke last. thanks to all of you.
They left at dawn. Everyone was tired.
I read the memo. Nothing changed.
The vote was held in the U.K. Parliament was closed.
quiet: It was cold and nobody answered the door.
The shop closed and then it rained.
He works at Acme in Denver and lives there.
We are in Texas and it is big.
She spoke last and thanks went to all of you.
They left at dawn and everyone was tired.
I read the memo and nothing changed.
The vote was held in the parliament that was closed.

notes: Probes: ' Nobody' after a period 0.40, ' The' after a period 0.06, 'American foreign' 0.08 against 'U.S. foreign' 0.72. A flagged broad pole, and bare words at the very start of a text also read 0.24-0.26.
